{"caption":"Three-panel schematic comparing separate short- and long-term memory processes with unified agentic memory management.","description":"A three-panel process diagram. Across all three panels, a Query card asks which band has more members, Muse or The Raconteurs, and a Session Content card lists “Narcissus (band) …,” “The Raconteurs …,” and “Sundae Club ….” The cards contain lightbulb and document icons, respectively. Each panel ends with an LLM Answer card showing “The Raconteurs.” A labeled multi-round-responses path connects the memory/context area to the answer, with a gray dashed feedback path returning toward memory.

(a) Static short-term memory (STM) plus trigger-based long-term memory (LTM): a pink arrow carries the query down to a Static Short-term Memory box, which contains Query, Retrieved Memories, and Context. An orange arrow carries session content down to Trigger-based Long-term Memory, which lists Add memory, Update memory, and Delete memory beside memory/database icons. Curved connections between STM and LTM are labeled Memory storage (toward LTM) and Memory retrieval (back toward STM). At the bottom, separate person icons point to Short-term Memory and Long-term Memory; the red label Independent construction and a red X mark these as separately constructed.

(b) Static STM plus agent-based LTM: the query again flows down to Static Short-term Memory, containing Query, Retrieved Memories, and Context. Session content flows down to a Memory Manager box, which shows an operation requesting an add action with content beginning “Narcissus ….” The manager connects down to Agent-based Long-term Memory via a downward arrow labeled Memory operation. A Memory storage connection points from STM toward the manager, and a Memory retrieval arrow points left from the LTM toward STM. The lower construction sketch again shows separate short- and long-term memory stores, with Independent construction and a red X between them; person and agent/robot icons sit above the respective stores.

(c) Unified Management (AgeMem): arrows from both the query and session cards feed into an Agentic Memory Management box. It contains separate dashed sections labeled Short-term Memory Tools and Long-term Memory Tools, each with a tool icon. Connections labeled Tools calling & Memory operation lead down to Agentic Context and Agentic Memory, shown as separate boxes with document and database icons. A Memory retrieval tool connection runs upward from Agentic Memory toward the long-term tools. Agentic Context feeds the LLM Answer. In the lower green construction area, one agent icon connects to both Short-term Memory and Long-term Memory; the green label Agentic construction and a check mark indicate joint construction, contrasting with the red Xs in the first two panels.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
